title: Senior Product Manager - Ecommerce
description:
Senior Product Manager eCommerce 
 PURPOSE 
 The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, commercial performance, and success of Evenica's eCommerce platform . This role focuses on understanding customer and market needs, defining what the platform should do and why, and prioritizing work that delivers the greatest customer and business value. 
 The Senior Product Manager will take ownership of an established product and platform , understand its existing capabilities, customers, roadmap, and processes, and help define its next stage of growth. The expectation is not simply to continue with what is already established, but to evaluate existing approaches, strengthen product practices where required, and establish a clear product direction based on customer, market, commercial, and business needs. 
 The Senior Product Manager partners closely with Engineering leadership, who own how the platform is built, and with Project Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and leadership to ensure the platform's direction supports Evenica's growth objectives. 
 EXPECTED OUTCOMES AND DELIVERABLES 
 Own the Product Strategy and Roadmap Own and evolve the product strategy and roadmap for the eCommerce platform, keeping it aligned with company goals, customer needs, and market opportunities. Understand the existing platform and roadmap and identify where product direction, processes, governance, or priorities should evolve. Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on business goals, customer needs, commercial impact, market opportunity, and the competitive landscape. Translate company strategy into clear product themes, initiatives, and measurable goals. Establish and improve product prioritization frameworks and decision-making processes where required. Present the roadmap, priorities, trade-offs, and reasoning behind decisions to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Balance short-term customer and project requirements with the long-term scalability and direction of the product. 
 Own Product Commercial Performance and P&L Take ownership of the commercial performance and P&L of the product . Track product revenue, costs, profitability, adoption, and return on product investments. Build business cases and ROI analyses to justify product investments and prioritization decisions. Track projected versus actual returns on major product initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer retention, adoption, and monetization. Contribute to pricing, packaging, and product investment decisions with leadership and other relevant stakeholders. 
 Bring the Voice of the Customer and Market into Product Decisions Engage directly with customers and merchants using the platform to gather qualitative and quantitative insights. Gather and evaluate feedback from project teams, Customer Success, Support, Sales, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders . Track market trends, competitor offerings, and industry benchmarks in eCommerce. Turn customer, project, and market research into clear opportunity assessments and product requirements. Ensure insights gathered during customer implementations are appropriately considered within the broader product roadmap. 
 Lead Product Discovery and Define What Gets Built Write clear, outcome-oriented requirements, user stories, business rules, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Bring in Design as needed to validate concepts before build. Prioritize the backlog based on customer value, business impact, strategic importance, commercial return, and effort. Validate requirements and assumptions before committing significant Engineering resources. Evaluate incoming requests to determine whether they represent a reusable product capability, configuration requirement, customer-specific customization, or defect. Ensure product decisions support a scalable platform rather than being driven only by individual customer requests. 
 Partner with Engineering on Delivery Work with Engineering leads on scope, sequencing, dependencies, and priorities, leaving architecture and implementation decisions to Engineering. Join sprint reviews, planning, refinement, and release discussions as appropriate to confirm the team is building the right thing. Resolve open product questions quickly so delivery is not blocked waiting on decisions. Review delivered functionality against requirements and expected customer and business outcomes. Balance immediate delivery requirements with the long-term maintainability and scalability of the platform. 
 Manage Stakeholders and Product Priorities Build strong working relationships with Engineering, Project Management, Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, leadership, customers, and partners. Manage competing priorities and expectations across stakeholders. Clearly communicate why initiatives are prioritized, deferred, changed, or declined. Present product strategy, roadmap, business cases, product performance, risks, and trade-offs to leadership. Establish appropriate product governance and decision-making practices to ensure priorities are managed consistently. 
 Define and Track What Success Looks Like Set and track KPIs such as: Revenue and profitability Conversion Average order value Customer retention Feature adoption Platform usage Customer satisfaction Return on product investment Monitor performance after launch and use what is learned to inform the next iteration. Report on product performance and business impact to leadership on a regular cadence. Ensure major product initiatives have clearly defined expected outcomes and success measures. 
 Lead Go-to-Market Planning Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support on launch plans, positioning, and enablement materials. Make sure customer-facing teams are prepared ahead of releases. Support strategic customer and sales discussions where product or roadmap expertise is required. Gather post-launch feedback and feed relevant learnings back into the roadmap. 
 Maintain Accurate Product Documentation Keep requirements, roadmaps, business cases, product decisions, and release notes current. Ensure internal teams can find accurate, up-to-date product information. Document key product decisions and the reasoning behind them. Maintain appropriate product policies, standards, and governance documentation. 
 REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Strategic Thinking: Envisioning the future; building plans and making decisions to achieve organizational goals; aligning product priorities with the strategic direction of the organization. Customer Focus: Seeks to understand customer and market needs and uses that understanding to shape product decisions and priorities. Commercial Ownership: Understands the financial impact of product decisions and balances customer value with revenue, profitability, and return on investment. Results Focus: Action-oriented; aligns people, work, and systems with business strategy to achieve measurable outcomes. Communication: Communicates information of varying complexity clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. Stakeholder Management: Builds alignment across teams while effectively managing competing requirements and priorities. Teamwork: Works cooperatively across teams and organizational boundaries to achieve shared goals. Adaptability: Adapts approach as business, customer, market, or product requirements change. Innovation: Thinks creatively and remains open to new ideas, technologies, and approaches. Continuous Learning: Regularly develops skills and knowledge to enhance personal and organizational performance. Initiative & Ownership: Proactively identifies opportunities and issues, takes accountability for decisions, and drives outcomes. 
 KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Proven ability to define and drive product strategy for a SaaS, eCommerce, or Commerce platform . Experience taking ownership of an established product and helping define its next stage of growth. Ability to assess existing product practices, challenge assumptions constructively, and introduce appropriate improvements to strategy, governance, prioritization, and execution. Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data to inform and defend product decisions. Experience with product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar. Experience with product management tools such as Jira, Productboard, Aha!, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar. Comfortable working across the full commerce platform, not just customer-facing UI/UX including how catalog, pricing, inventory, order, customer, and payment data flow between systems and integrate with third parties. Able to build business cases and ROI analyses to justify investment and prioritization decisions. Comfortable owning the financial accountability of product decisions and tracking projected versus actual returns. Experience managing or contributing to product P&L, revenue, profitability, or commercial performance . Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences. Experience running user research and validating decisions using customer feedback, analytics, experimentation, or A/B testing. Comfortable prioritizing and saying no; able to explain product trade-offs clearly to stakeholders. Strong understanding of stakeholder and requirements management. Strong plus: understanding of ERP systems and how they integrate with a commerce platform, including inventory, pricing, order management, fulfillment, and financial systems. Good to have: understanding of eCommerce payment systems including gateways, processors, fraud and risk, and reconciliation. Strong understanding of general eCommerce concepts including conversion funnels, checkout, merchandising, catalog management, pricing, and promotions. Experience with Microsoft technologies or Microsoft-based platforms such as Azure, .NET, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or related commerce technologies is a plus. 
 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of Product Management experience , including preferably at least 2 years focused on eCommerce, Commerce, or SaaS platforms. Experience working directly with Engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment. Experience working with enterprise customers and complex cross-functional stakeholder environments preferred. Required to pursue and stay up to date with training modules, courses, and certifications as prescribed by Evenica. 
 WORKING CONDITIONS & TRAVEL Typically required to work Monday to Friday during designated business hours. Some overtime outside standard working hours may be required depending on business and customer requirements. Hybrid expectations to complete work in office and at home. Some travel, including international travel, may be required. Attendance in office when required. 
 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Required to sit and work at a computer approximately 90% of the time. Repetitive wrist strain. Ability and dexterity to operate a computer, keyboard, and basic hardware. 
 RELATIONSHIPS Works closely with Engineering leadership to align the product roadmap with technical capacity and constraints. Works with Project Management and implementation teams to understand customer requirements and project feedback. Brings in Design as needed for discovery and validation. Collaborates with Marketing and Sales on go-to-market strategy and positioning. Engages with Customer Success and Support to gather feedback and prioritize issues. Works with leadership on product strategy, P&L, investment decisions, and performance. Engages as needed with customers, partners, and external stakeholders. 
 PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT Opportunity to increase scope and responsibility as the company and product continue to grow. Opportunity to influence the future direction and maturity of Evenica's product management practices. Promotion to senior product leadership roles is possible with experience and strong performance.

Key Skills: Product Strategy,Requirements Management,Product Management,eCommerce,Product Ownership,P&L Management,Product Roadmap,SaaS

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Associate Product Manager, Data & Interoperability 
Saisystems Health | Product Organization | Reports to Manager, Product Operations
 Location: India (Pune)
Shift : EST Shift timing ( 05.30pm IST to 02.30 am IST )
 
 What Youll Do 
 Support the Principal PM for Data & Interoperability in managing specifications, testing, and documentation for data services and integration products.
 Write detailed technical specifications, API documentation, and data flow diagrams for integration features.
¢ Conduct validation testing for FHIR APIs, HL7 interfaces, and data exchange workflows.
¢ Support data preparation and organization efforts that enable AI initiatives across the product portfolio including data cataloging, quality auditing, and ensuring datasets are structured and accessible for machine learning workloads.
¢ Monitor data quality metrics and integration health dashboards, escalating issues proactively.
¢ Coordinate with engineering teams on integration testing, partner onboarding, and data migration activities.
¢ Maintain documentation for interoperability standards compliance, certification requirements, and partner integrations.
¢ Analyze usage data for data services and APIs to identify adoption patterns and improvement areas.
¢ Build Proof of Concept with help of Integration engines for developing API as part of healthcare data exchange.
 What You Bring 
¢ Overall years of experience 5+ with (1 to 3 years of experience in product management), technical writing, business analysis, or a data/integration-focused role.
¢ Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards (HL7, CCDA, FHIR, EDI -X12 (Eligibility and Claims management) or API-based integrations.
¢ Experience with one of the healthcare integration engines like Mirth/Rhapsody/Cloverleaf/IRIS/Bridgegate Vorro
¢ Strong technical aptitude and comfort reading API documentation and data schemas.
¢ Interest in AI/ML concepts and how well-organized data powers intelligent product features.
¢ Experience with Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies & 
¢ Strong experience and SQL and Database.
¢ Excellent written skills and communication skills, particularly for technical documentation.
 
 
 How You Lead 
¢ You are technically curious, going deep on data models and integration patterns to ensure accuracy.
¢ You document thoroughly, creating specifications that engineering teams can build from without ambiguity.
¢ You are proactive in identifying data quality issues and integration gaps understanding that clean data is the foundation for both interoperability and AI.
¢ You bridge technical and product conversations, making complex data concepts accessible.
 Why This Role Matters 
Interoperability and AI-readiness are the future of healthcare IT. This role ensures the data services that power both are well-specified, thoroughly tested, and clearly documented laying the groundwork for intelligent product experiences across the portfolio.
